import json,sympy as s
x=s.symbols('x',real=True);chi=s.symbols('chi',positive=True);w=s.symbols('w',positive=True)
phi=s.exp(-x*x/(2*s.sqrt(chi)))/(s.pi*s.sqrt(chi))**s.Rational(1,4)
norm=s.integrate(phi**2,(x,-s.oo,s.oo));K=s.integrate(chi*s.diff(phi,x)**2,(x,-s.oo,s.oo));G=s.integrate(x*x*phi**2,(x,-s.oo,s.oo))
assert norm==1 and s.simplify(K-s.sqrt(chi)/2)==0 and s.simplify(G-s.sqrt(chi)/2)==0
assert s.simplify(-chi*s.diff(phi,x,2)+x*x*phi-s.sqrt(chi)*phi)==0
odd=x*phi
assert s.integrate(phi*odd,(x,-s.oo,s.oo))==0
assert s.simplify(-chi*s.diff(odd,x,2)+x*x*odd-3*s.sqrt(chi)*odd)==0
assert s.simplify(G-chi/(4*K))==0
# Q is a CONSTANT internal projector. With Q mass w, total kinetic cap B gives
# ||x Q psi||² >=chi*w²/(4B); deleting w² is false for a mostly-P state.
wrong=s.simplify(w*G-chi/(4*K)); assert wrong.subs(w,s.Rational(1,4))<0
print(json.dumps({'kind':'EXACT_QUANTUM_DARK_POINT_ANTICONCENTRATION_METHOD_NOT_NATIVE','zero_point_loop':'x=0','ground_loop_norm2':str(G),'ground_kinetic':str(K),'allvector_constant_Q_lower':'chi*w_Q^2/(4 B_total)','whole_ground_removal':'odd x*phi orthogonal to BOTH degenerate internal ground channels','source_excitation_energy':str(2*s.sqrt(chi)),'wrong_deleted_Q_mass_rejected':True,'field_dependent_Q_derivative_shortcut_allowed':False,'native_ground_or_phase':False},sort_keys=True))
